name: nonApi_recordRunsPageJob
description: Writes one HC.IntegrationJob row (IntegrationId 6, 'Runs page') per runs-page import — a timer run, an 'import now', or a portal Test that imported (2026-10-05). It feeds the AI tile on the portal's Usage Data monitor, which replaced the Facebook tile. For integration 6 the columns mean: RecordsRead = runs the model found; RecordsWritten = runs inserted + updated; RecordsSuccessInfo = '<inserted>|<updated>', machine-read by hcportal_getUsageData for the 14-day split (this SP is the only writer; change both together). SequenceNumber is MAX + 1 for integration 6 under UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK. Counts are clamped to SMALLINT (LEAST(…, 32767)) and the info strings cut to 4000 because that is what HC.IntegrationJob holds. Called by the API only; no auth. Returns nothing; a runtime error is rolled back, logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

parameters.name: startedAt
parameters.description: When the import began. NULL ⇒ now (the row then has startedAt = endedAt). Default NULL.

parameters.name: runsFound
parameters.description: Runs the model read off the pages. Clamped to 32767. Column is SMALLINT.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT vs column SMALLINT — clamped with LEAST(…, 32767) in the SP.

parameters.name: runsInserted
parameters.description: New HC runs. Summed into RecordsWritten (SMALLINT, clamped) and written verbatim into RecordsSuccessInfo as '<inserted>|<updated>'.

parameters.name: errorCount
parameters.description: Errors during the run. Clamped to 32767.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT vs column SMALLINT — clamped.

parameters.name: errorInfo
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(MAX) vs column NVARCHAR(4000) — trimmed with LEFT.

parameters.name: kennelsSucceeded
parameters.description: Kennels whose page imported cleanly. Clamped to 32767.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT vs column SMALLINT — clamped.

parameters.name: kennelsSucceededInfo
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(MAX) vs column NVARCHAR(4000) — trimmed with LEFT.

parameters.name: kennelsFailed
parameters.description: Kennels whose page failed. Clamped to 32767.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT vs column SMALLINT — clamped.

parameters.name: kennelsFailedInfo
parameters.description: Their names/ids and reasons; cut to 4000.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter NVARCHAR(MAX) vs column NVARCHAR(4000) — trimmed with LEFT.

sideEffects: Inserts one HC.IntegrationJob row (IntegrationId 6, endedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), RecordsFailedInfo NULL) inside a transaction; the sequence read takes UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK on HC.IntegrationJob rows for integration 6.
On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>'), then THROWs.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
